fields.name: to
fields.coerce: `to.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "")`, then compared with the lower-case name of each character in the database. A missing or non-string `to` throws (see Notes)
fields.description: The character that gets the mail. It can be offline or on another server.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject, up to 74 characters.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The text, up to 1,000 characters.

fields.name: item
fields.description: If truthy, the server attaches the item in inventory slot 0 (`items[0]`). An empty slot or a `placeholder` sends the mail without an item, for 48,000 gold.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Copied unchanged into the later `mail_sent` or `mail_failed` reply. Not tested as true or false.

responses.name: Sending
responses.when: All checks pass. The server took the gold (and the item) and starts the delivery. It comes after a `player` update with `reopen`.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: place
fields.description: The request.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: sucess
fields.description: Always `false`. The source misspells it; `success` is `true`.

fields.name: in_progress
fields.description: The delivery runs.

fields.name: received
fields.description: Always `"unknown"`.

responses.name: Sent
responses.when: Later: the mail is in the database.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code. The object has no `place`.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The `to` of the request, unchanged.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its code event.

responses.name: Delivery failed
responses.when: Later: the delivery failed. The server keeps the gold. For `nocharacter`, `nouser` and `unknown`, it gives the item back if you are online and have a free slot. Then a `player` update with `reopen` follows. Else you lose the item. For `coms_failure`, you always lose the item. A missing or non-string `to` throws before the first `await` of the delivery, so that `mail_failed` (`coms_failure`) comes at once, before the `player` update and `mail_sending`.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code. The object has no `place`.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The `to` of the request, unchanged. Absent when `to` was missing.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The `request_id` of the request.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its code event.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: `nocharacter`: no character has that name. `nouser`: the account of the receiver or of the sender is missing. `unknown`: the database transaction failed. `coms_failure`: an error, for example a missing or non-string `to`.

rows.when: `item` is truthy, slot 0 holds an item, and the item has the lock `l`.
`item` is truthy, and the item in slot 0 is bound (`b`) or came from PvP (`v`).
`item` is truthy, slot 0 holds an item, and you have less than 360,000 gold.

also.when: All checks pass, before `mail_sending`. Again later, after `mail_failed`, when the server gives the item back.
also.summary: Your character with `reopen: true`: less `gold`, and slot 0 empty when the mail has the item.

order: later: `game_response` `mail_sent`, or `mail_failed` (then `player` if the item came back)
